# v2.29 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-releases **v2.27-dev … v2.29-dev** since the
previous stable (v2.26). It introduces **Offerings** and adds a **public API for
partner programs**.

## New: Offerings

Track a partner's ability to deliver a **joint product offering** — a bundle of
one or more **specialisations**, where each specialisation lists the supporting
trainings a partner needs to deliver it. Offerings sit alongside Programs with
their own navigation section and dashboards.

### What's new

- **Create offerings** under **Admin → Offerings** — each with a name,
  description, link, and one or more specialisations (the same list as
  Admin → Specialisations). For every specialisation you choose which
  **Certifications, Accreditations, ILTs and OLXs** support it, with
  **alternatives** (any one counts) and a **minimum required** number.
- **Navigation** — an **Offerings** section in the sidebar lists every configured
  offering as a child link (refreshing automatically), and the admin **Offerings**
  page is reachable from both the **admin sidebar submenu** (under Program Data)
  and a card on the **admin overview** page (`/admin`).
- **Onshore / Offshore view** — open an offering, pick a **Country** or
  **Region**, and see, per specialisation:
  - **Onshore** — distinct people holding each training in the selected country
    (or region), with a **Met / Not met** badge against the minimum required.
  - **Offshore** — the rest of that theatre (all other countries in the theatre,
    with the onshore countries removed) — the wider capability available to
    support delivery.
  - Nothing is shown until you select a country or region.
- **Drill-down & export** — click **View** on any count to list the people behind
  it, and use **Export** (CSV / Excel / PDF) for the current view.
- **Import / Export on the admin page** — round-trip your offerings (offering,
  description, link, specialisation, training, minimum, alternatives) as
  CSV / Excel, with a downloadable template and a dry-run validation preview.
- **Public API** — `GET /api/public/v1/offerings` returns offering definitions;
  add `?country=` or `?region=` for Onshore/Offshore compliance figures scoped to
  your API key's companies (`?name=` narrows to one offering).

## New: Public API for partner programs

The read-only **public API** now covers partner **programs**, matching the
coverage that already existed for students, training records, reports and
offerings. External systems holding a company-scoped API key can read program
compliance data directly.

- **`GET /api/public/v1/programs`** — lists the configured partner programs, each
  with its configured levels, whether it uses a per-theatre minimum, and whether
  it's tiered.
- **`GET /api/public/v1/programs/{programName}`** — full per-program compliance,
  the same data the in-app program dashboard shows:
  - **`?level=country|region|theatre|global`** with `?country=`, `?region=` or
    `?theatre=` to pick the scope.
  - **`?horizonMonths=3|6|12`** for a forward-looking projection that surfaces
    upcoming certificate expiries before they break compliance.
  - **Tier ladders and deployment requirements** for tiered programs.
  - **`?trainingTitle=...&students=true`** to list the people who hold a given
    training.
- Both endpoints are advertised in the API index (`GET /api/public/v1`) and
  documented in the in-app **Help → Public API** section.
- Like the rest of the public API, program data is **read-only**, scoped to the
  companies your API key can read, rate-limited per key, and returns no rows for a
  company the key isn't granted.

## Also improved

- **Backups now include Programs and Offerings** — both the **full** backup and
  the **config** backup carry the offering + program reference data, and both
  restore paths rebuild them. Older archives without these files still restore
  exactly as before.

## Notes

- Includes a database migration that adds the new **offering** tables. It runs
  automatically on update. The public Program API added no database changes.
- Offering and program compliance figures are scoped to the company selected in
  the header.

No action needed after updating beyond the automatic migration.
